name: comparison-02
description: The lift of a variant over the control, with a 95% confidence interval drawn against zero and what it means.

'use client' import { BlockStateProvider, BlockStateRows, BlockStateText, type BlockStatus, getBlockState, } from '@/registry/components/dashboardblocks/block-state' import { IntervalBar, compareProportions, } from '@/registry/components/dashboardblocks/comparison' import { Details } from '@/registry/components/dashboardblocks/details' import { KPIValue } from '@/registry/components/dashboardblocks/kpi' import { formatNumber, formatPercent, formatSigned, } from '@/registry/lib/dashboardblocks/format' import { cn } from '@/lib/utils' interface Variant { conversions: number label: string /** The short name the test uses, such as `A`. */ name: string visitors: number } interface Comparison2Props { /** Leave out, with `variant`, to show the empty state. */ control?: Variant description: string metric: string status?: BlockStatus title: string variant?: Variant } const exampleProps: Comparison2Props = { control: { conversions: 1_208, label: 'Current checkout', name: 'A', visitors: 24_150, }, description: 'Day 14 of a 50/50 split test', metric: 'Checkout conversion', title: 'One-page checkout test', variant: { conversions: 1_342, label: 'One-page checkout', name: 'B', visitors: 24_080, }, } const percent = (value: number, digits = 1) => formatSigned(value, (magnitude) => formatPercent(magnitude, { maximumFractionDigits: digits, minimumFractionDigits: digits, }), ) const rate = (value: number) => formatPercent(value, { maximumFractionDigits: 2, minimumFractionDigits: 2 }) function verdict(result: ReturnType, variant: Variant) { const { name } = variant if (!result.significant) { return `The interval still crosses zero, so ${name}'s lift could be chance. Keep the test running.` } return result.lift > 0 ? `The whole interval is above zero, so ${name} is very likely better.` : `The whole interval is below zero, so ${name} is very likely worse.` } const Comparison2 = (props: Comparison2Props) => { const { control, description, metric, status, title, variant } = props const state = getBlockState(status, !control || !variant) if (state || !control || !variant) { return (
